status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol_rd, randomSeed=17)
if status != 0: raise RuntimeError('Conformer embedding failed')
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mol_rd, maxIters=500)
conf=mol_rd.GetConformer()
atom_lines=[]

 atom_lines.append(f'{atom.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.8f} {p.y:.8f} {p.z:.8f}')
qm=gto.M(atom=';'.join(atom_lines), basis='def2-svp', charge=0, spin=0, verbose=0)
method=dft.RKS(qm)
method.xc='B3LYP'
method.conv_tol=1e-9
E=method.kernel()
moe=np.sort(method.mo_energy)
homo_idx=qm.nelectron//2-1
homo_e=float(moe[homo_idx]); lumo_e=float(moe[homo_idx+1])
print('Input SELFIES decoded:',smi)
print('Molecular formula:',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mol_rd))

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pyscf import gto, dft
import numpy as np

mol_rd=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))

 p=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx())
 atom_lines.append(f'{atom.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.8f} {p.y:.8f} {p.z:.8f}')
qm=gto.M(atom=';'.join(atom_lines), basis='def2-svp', charge=0, spin=0, verbose=0)

method.xc='B3LYP'
